__NOTOC__ == Commendation of Valor == [[File:Item Commendation of Valor.png|right|thumb|320px|Commendation of Valor]] * Introduced in [[Update 20]] * [[Bind#Bound to Character|Bound to Character]] * Often abbreviated '''CoV''' === Drop locations === * [[Epic quests]] on [[difficulty|difficulties]] higher than Casual * End rewards for epic quests ** You must not have a [[Quest ransack]] XP penalty when completing the quest. ** The amount depends on the level and difficulty of the quest ([[#Amount per quest level and difficulty|see below]]). === Usage === Double clicking a Commendation of Valor brings up a Barter UI with the following options: {|class="wikitable" |- !Item!!Bind!!Amount required |- |{{Item|Potion of Insightful Ability|Potion of Insightful Ability (+2)}}||Bound to Account|| 40 |- |{{Item|Potion of Spellpower|Potion of Spellpower (+25)}}||Bound to Account|| 35 |- |{{Item|Potion of Prowess|Potion of Prowess (+2)}}||Bound to Account|| 35 |- |[[Iconic True Heart of Wood]]||Bound to Account|| 4200 |- |[[Epic Heart of Wood]]||Bound to Account|| 4200 |- |[[Heart Seed]]||Bound to Account|| 100 |} As of [[Update 20 Patch 1]], Heart Seed option has been implemented. 42 of these can be traded in for Iconic or Epic Heart of Wood. As Heart Seeds are Bound to Account, not Character, players with Account Storage are now able to accumulate their Heart Seeds account-wide towards a Heart for the character they want. See {{Forums|431029|DDO Forums CoV Dev Update}}. ==== Crafting ==== CoV are also used as an ingredient to create [[Thunder-Forged]] and [[Legendary Green Steel items]], and can drop in raid and rare encounter chests in the related areas. === Amount per quest level and difficulty === The amount of CoV rewarded upon completion depend on the quest level (modified by the choice of difficulty) and the difficulty the quest was run on. The amount is given by * Multiplier*(QuestLevel - 17) * Multiplier is 2 for Epic Normal, 3 for Epic Hard and 5 for Epic Elite. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: left" border="1" !colspan="2"|Epic Normal!!colspan="2"|Epic Hard!!colspan="2"|Epic Elite |- !Quest

It is also valid for raids that can be run on epic difficulty. [[File:CommsDDO.png]] As of [[Update 21]], The XP bonus found on Experience Elixirs, VIP bonuses, Guild Airship amenities and items now also increases the Commendation of Valor return found in End Reward lists. These bonuses are calculated individually. Please see [[Commendation of Valor XP Bonus Gains]] for more details. [[Tome of Learning|Tomes of Learning]] do not provide a boost to CoV rewards. === Bonus Days and server-side parameter === DDO Bonus Days event can increase the amount given per a reward list. This means that above number is not hard-coded and can be changed by server-side parameter. As of {{GameRevisionDates|May 8 2014}}, 100 CoV limit on reward list has been removed and it should now return the calculated amount of CoV ({{Forums|p=5328731}}). === Tips === Claimed Commendations of Valor do not automatically stack with other commendations in the inventory and aren't auto-gathered by ingredients bags. Be wary of this when collecting large numbers, as they can quickly occupy large backpack spaces. (This only applies to Commendations from end reward lists - they will be auto-gathered if looted from a chest.) They can be manually stacked; the Maximum Commendation stack size is 99,999 for one inventory slot. === See also === For more information: [[Commendation_of_Valor_XP_Bonus_Gains|Commendation of Valor XP Bonus Gains]] has a detailed explanation of how your reward is calculated.
